section_completion_log.section_name: Quality and efficiency of the implementation

revision_actions.description: Expand the primary supervisor's evidenced track record and supervision capacity, and make explicit how the two-supervisor structure delivers postdoctoral-level supervision despite the associate-level primary role.
revision_actions.reason: Section 1.3 already makes the compensating two-supervisor/specialist structure and prior LANDRACES MSCA-hosting capacity explicit, but strengthening the primary supervisor's evidenced track record with additional representative publications, supervision history or grant leadership requires project facts absent from Tier 3 (§13.3 — no further supervisor publications or supervision-history data exist in the consortium capabilities inputs) and rewritten prose in sub-section 1.3; Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision, so it is deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Add bounded, project-controlled quantified magnitude indicators (lead time, water-productivity measurement, reuse/adoption milestones) alongside the referenced literature context to evidence the magnitude of contribution from the project's own metrics.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 2.3 deliberately declines to state any quantified project-level magnitude target and names only the metrics it will measure (warning lead time, water productivity, etc.) without bounded target ranges; adding bounded quantified indicators requires new/rewritten prose and target figures not present in Tier 3, and Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision — deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle affecting sub-section 2.3.

revision_actions.description: Secure written confirmation of the AgroVIR placement arrangement and reframe the exploitation pathway so its credibility no longer rests on assumed partner commitments.
revision_actions.reason: The AgroVIR placement supervisor, team, track record and person-months remain operator-declared assumptions in the draft; obtaining written confirmation is a grant-preparation action producing project facts absent from Tier 3 (§13.3), and reframing sub-section 2.2 so exploitation credibility no longer depends on assumed items requires rewritten prose — Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision, so it is deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Advance and evidence written field access for the WP3 validation site before grant signature, and harden the contingency so the critical-path validation has a genuinely available fallback.
revision_actions.reason: WP3 written field access (T3.1) and the site identity remain declared assumptions and the Szentendre Skanzen contingency is itself conditional; securing and evidencing access is a grant-preparation action producing project facts absent from Tier 3 (§13.3), and hardening the contingency in sub-section 3.1 requires rewritten prose — Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision, so it is deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Confirm partner in-kind person-months in writing and clearly separate the fellow's confirmed 30 PM from unconfirmed partner estimates in the effort-appropriateness argument.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 3.1 already separates the fellow's confirmed 30 PM from the operator-declared partner in-kind estimates (ATK 2.5, ELTE 2.0, AgroVIR 3.0, MATE 2.4, Krumatic 1.5), but obtaining written partner confirmation of those person-months requires project facts absent from Tier 3 (§13.3) and is a grant-preparation action; Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision, so the confirmation ask is deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle affecting sub-section 3.1.

revision_actions.description: Anchor each of the four 'refused assumptions' to named state-of-the-art references or methods so the beyond-SOTA claim is benchmarked rather than characterised abstractly.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 1.1 frames the four refused assumptions conceptually without citing named competing literature; anchoring each to specific state-of-the-art references requires new prose and bibliographic content not present in Tier 3, and Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision — deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle affecting sub-section 1.1.

revision_actions.description: Reinforce the researcher's data-science/EO competence with additional concrete outputs to show the developmental gap is narrow and evidenced.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 1.4 candidly records the middle-authored, recent EO publications and non-publication evidence; reinforcing it with additional concrete outputs (datasets, code, first-author or in-preparation work) requires project facts absent from Tier 3 (§13.3) and rewritten prose — Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision, so it is deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle affecting sub-section 1.4.

revision_actions.description: Raise or better justify the publication target relative to the available datasets and name target venues/output types to demonstrate an ambition-matched dissemination plan.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-sections 2.1/2.2 state the 'at least two, possible third' target without naming target venues or raising/further justifying it against the dataset richness; changing the target or adding venue detail requires rewritten prose (and, for venues, content not present in Tier 3), and Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision — deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle affecting sub-section 2.2.

revision_actions.description: Reassign WP3 leadership/accountability to the beneficiary while retaining the farmer site as the validation environment.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 3.1 still records WP3 as led by 'the independent commercial-farmer validation site'; reassigning WP3 leadership to the beneficiary while retaining the farmer site as validation environment requires rewritten work-plan prose and a change to the canonical WP-lead structure, which Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision on — deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle affecting sub-section 3.1.
